##### Project general facts

Park Beach Residence II is a contemporary residential development that brings together elegant architecture, premium comfort, and a resort-inspired lifestyle. Designed with clean modern lines and sophisticated interiors, the project offers spacious residences filled with natural light and thoughtfully planned layouts that create a seamless balance between style and functionality. Every home has been crafted to provide privacy while maintaining a strong connection to the surrounding landscape, making Park Beach Residence II an ideal destination for those seeking refined coastal living.

Residents enjoy an exceptional collection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote wellness, recreation, and relaxation. The development features a covered infinity swimming pool, private pools in selected residences, a state-of-the-art fitness center, beautifully landscaped gardens, expansive green park areas, an outdoor cinema, mini golf, terrace lounge spaces, and dedicated children's play areas. Every amenity has been carefully curated to create a vibrant community where leisure and everyday living come together effortlessly.

The residences are finished with high-quality modern materials that reflect the project's contemporary design philosophy and commitment to lasting quality. Elegant interiors combine premium finishes with spacious layouts to deliver comfort and sophistication throughout. Each home features a Smart Home system and a fully equipped kitchen with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their living spaces according to their own style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
